title: derby01: the town generator
description: The recipe the town generator follows to lay out a town from a map number (1 to 99999) for a number of cars (2 to 8): the same number and cars always give the same town, as a layout like data/town.json. Three blocks each way round an open square: a ring road you can lap, two-lane streets, the office with its deck and canopy on the square, bays, islands, the kiosk and a shed; office blocks, some with an alley through or an L round a yard; a park with the pavilion and a small car park; lamp posts and rowans along the streets. The town grows with the cars. Used when rounds.json says map: generated (the default). Ranges are [smallest, largest]: the generator picks between them.

perCar.description: Square metres of town for each car: the blocks and the square grow (the streets stay as wide) until the town has this much per car.

minScale.description: The town never shrinks below this share of its natural size, however few the cars: smaller blocks couldn't hold a building, nor the square a car park.

blocks.description: The blocks round the square, before scaling.

w.description: Width of the blocks west and east of the square.

d.description: Depth of the blocks north and south of it.

square.description: The open square in the middle, the office car park: room to brawl and drift.

bays.description: Rows of parking bays on it.

stalls.description: Stalls along each side of a row.

corners.description: Corners of the town cut off on the slant: sweeping bends on the ring.

cuts.description: How many of the four corners are cut (the same one may come up twice).

length.description: How much each cut takes off, before scaling.

spokes.description: Streets from the square's corners to the ring left out: two blocks become one, and a street ends in a T.

none.description: Chance that none is left out.

one.description: Otherwise, the chance that just one is (else two).

exits.description: Streets that run on out of town, closed by a barrier.

office.description: The office on the square, with the concrete deck and the yellow canopy in front.

stairs.description: Chance a brick one gets a yellow stairwell on an end.

deck.description: The deck's longest, in metres (it is half the front at most).

brick.description: Heights a brick building may be (one is picked).

white.description: Heights a white building may be.

switch.description: Chance the next building in a row changes look.

alley.description: Chance a long block gets an alley through it (the first always does).

yard.description: Chance a big block is an L round a yard.

lamps.description: Lamp posts along the pavements, on alternate sides.

trees.description: Rowans along the streets, and the odd poplar.

ring.description: Chance a stretch of the ring has trees.

poplars.description: Chance a street tree is a poplar.

pieces.description: Which piece of data/pieces.json the generator puts down for each thing. Pick one of a like size.

boulder.description: Boulders by the exits (given a radius).

heights.description: Heights in metres, one picked at random (list one twice to make it likelier). A floor is 3.4 m.
